script.text: Your patients are already asking about peptides for their skin. Copper peptides. Collagen. Tanning shots. Growth-hormone boosters. Most skin peptides reach your clinic before any evidence does. Hormones and Peptides for Skin gives you the evidence, graded. Seven short modules: the skin's own hormones, systemic hormones, fat and incretins, matrix peptides, hair and pigment, growth hormone, and the rules. Sort the trials from the brochures. Spot the red flags on a certificate. Practise the conversations you're already having, with the rules for your country. Over four hundred sources. Six jurisdictions. Every module reviewed by a physician. Be the clinician with real answers, and build a skin service you can stand behind. Enrol today at Hormonaly Academy.
